description: This file is a shell script that includes test cases for the 'git pack-redundant' command, used to identify redundant packs within Git repositories. It contains setup functions, test scenarios, expected outcomes, and related comments detailing the pack and object relationships for various test cases.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a given Git repository and assigns commit OIDs to shell variables.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in a specified repository from commit data and assigns the pack ID to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats and sorts pack file identifiers extracted from the output.
